relations.note: the paper, lighter, and no thanks
relations.quote: The paper's lighter than it was, Father.

story.body: You told your father the paper was lighter than it was. He would not thank the cause, and you did not name it. Anne took the house down the lane and left the sword on the nail. Susanna asked if a gentleman had only promised. You gave her the same word you gave him, and no payer. Gilbert was a comparison in your father's mouth. He was not in the shop.
